findings.highlight: as I managed to get about three hours of sleep
findings.evidenceJa: 三時間ほど眠れたのか
findings.governingReading: perhaps I managed around three hours of sleep
findings.explanation: Shirou’s estimate, inferred from his relatively clear head, becomes a factual cause of that clarity.

findings.highlight: As soon as I get up
findings.evidenceJa: 立ち上がろうとした矢先
findings.governingReading: just as I try to stand
findings.explanation: mirror moon completes Shirou’s rise before his foot slips, while the Japanese has the failure interrupt the attempt.
A concrete breakfast ingredient is replaced by a different cured meat.

findings.evidenceJa: なんとか食卓を彩ってみる
findings.governingReading: somehow manage to give the breakfast table a little color
findings.explanation: Shirou’s effort to make a limited bread breakfast presentable disappears into a headcount.

findings.evidenceJa: 茶碗と箸を持つセイバー
findings.governingReading: Saber holding a rice bowl and chopsticks
findings.explanation: Half the contrasting Japanese place-setting image is omitted.

findings.governingReading: French cuisine in the style of the Café Marly
findings.explanation: Shirou’s mock-specific cosmopolitan elaboration of Taiga’s “France” joke disappears.
The imagined heatproof coating belongs to Taiga’s esophagus, not her throat.

findings.evidenceJa: マーガリンを塗りたくる
findings.explanation: Taiga’s excessive, characterizing application becomes neutral placement.

findings.highlight: makes me feel like I can trust her
findings.governingReading: makes me feel as secure as if aboard a great ship
findings.explanation: A conventional image of complete reassurance becomes a direct judgment of Taiga’s trustworthiness.

findings.highlight: it doesn’t hurt, so there’s no problem
findings.evidenceJa: 痛みはないしちゃんと動く
findings.governingReading: there is no pain and it still moves properly, so there is no problem
findings.explanation: mirror moon omits the second piece of evidence Shirou uses to rationalize concealing his condition.

findings.highlight: took that hammer-like blow to her chest
findings.evidenceJa: 胸に受けて咳き込んでいた
findings.governingReading: took Kuzuki’s hammerlike blow to the chest and was left coughing
findings.explanation: The visible respiratory consequence used in Shirou’s comparison disappears.

findings.highlight: I didn’t actually take a hit
findings.evidenceJa: 実際に傷を負っていない
findings.governingReading: I have not actually suffered a wound
findings.explanation: Shirou denies injury, not that any harmful event reached him; “no hit” erases his severe internal magical backlash.
The prolonged numbness’s depressive psychological weight becomes ordinary concern.

findings.evidenceJa: 大きな動きはなかったんだろう
findings.explanation: Shirou’s self-serving inference from Rin not approaching him becomes certainty.

findings.evidenceJa: 和室に聞こえるぐらいの大声
findings.governingReading: call out loudly enough to be heard in the Japanese room
findings.explanation: The purposeful volume and expected listener location disappear.

findings.governingReading: my sense of its position is still misaligned
findings.explanation: The dangerous mismatch between intended and actual hand movement is again reduced to numbness alone.
